name: @open-hax/eta-mu-monorepo
description: Canonical eta-mu monorepo spanning GitHub automation, truth/docs kernels, Promethean runtime, and absorbed OpenHax surfaces

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @openhax/opencode-reactant build && pnpm --filter @openhax/agentd build && pnpm --dir packages/eta-mu-github build && pnpm --dir packages/presence-core build && pnpm --dir packages/kanban build
scripts.test: pnpm --dir packages/eta-mu-github test && node --test packages/eta-mu-docs/tests/*.test.cjs && node --test packages/eta-mu-truth/tests/*.test.cjs && pnpm --dir packages/presence-core test && pnpm --dir packages/kanban test && node --test packages/signal-contracts/tests/*.test.cjs && node --test packages/signal-radar-core/tests/*.test.cjs && node --test packages/signal-source-utils/tests/*.test.cjs && node --test packages/signal-watchlists/tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir packages/eta-mu-github typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/presence-core typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/kanban exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
